scope: freertos fixed task for mhz19b, bus=uart_polling, board=stm32f103rb; contract describes only APIs needed by the copied reference driver and task fixed binding.

task_binding.backend: STM32CubeF1 HAL UART with FreeRTOS timing

operations.name: HAL_UART_Transmit
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_UART_Transmit(UART_HandleTypeDef *, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: polling API used directly by reference; honor parameters and return value.

operations.name: HAL_UART_Receive
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_UART_Receive(UART_HandleTypeDef *, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: polling API used directly by reference; honor parameters and return value.

api_contract.preconditions: Caller provides the task-configured and initialized peripheral handle; helper APIs have the RTOS/HAL context documented in the baseline pack.

facts.requirement: Retain the UART_HandleTypeDef handle bound to the fixed UART2/huart2 instance, configured for 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, and 1 stop bit; the caller configures the bus and passes it in.

Retain the polling operations actually used by the reference implementation: HAL_UART_Transmit, HAL_UART_Receive. Parameter and return semantics must support the uart_polling access required by mhz19b.
